race.description: Corowa Machinery Services Country Boosted Mdn Plate
race.comment: GOLD DECREE (3) has the most reliable exposed maiden form, with a long-neck second at Wagga two starts ago followed by a fourth there when still respected in betting. The 1.5kg apprentice claim is useful and his record around 1300m, while still winless, shows enough consistency to make him the one to beat. DUKE OF ZHOU (2) was disappointing as favourite at Albury after an early bump, though his Wagga third prior and two placings around 1300m keep him in the mix. KINDUKU (7) is a debutant from a strong local stable profile and has had a close Hawkesbury trial. Can make an immediate impact. COCO MOJO (9) last-start Albury third was better and barrier one helps. In the mix.
